title: Fotografía de Moda Surreal con Bloque de Hielo: Mujer Escandinava en Vestido Carmesí Congelada en Hielo Transparente
prompt: Create a surreal fashion editorial photograph featuring a young Scandinavian woman with platinum blonde hair standing encased inside a large vertical block of transparent ice. She wears a vibrant crimson red pleated maxi dress with subtle Nordic geometric patterns at the hem that contrasts sharply with the cold blue tones of the ice. Her long hair is voluminous and wavy with small ice crystals forming in the strands. At the base of the ice block is a frozen arrangement of deep red arctic poppies and purple heather mixed with dried birch branches and moss. She holds a thin curved branch of Norwegian spruce in her hand. The background is a deep blue-teal gradient suggesting the colors of Nordic winter twilight. The lighting is cinematic and cool-toned, highlighting realistic frost patterns, cracks, and air bubbles within the ice to create a mysterious ethereal atmosphere evoking Scandinavian winter mythology.
